tags.name: Authentication session
tags.description: Session, role and account security contracts

tags.name: QR login
tags.description: Browser-bound LOGIN challenge with explicit authenticated approval

put.summary: Select the active role for the current session

200.description: Role selected with a fresh session snapshot

post.summary: Issue WebSocket ticket
post.description: Generate short-lived (30s, single-use) ticket for WebSocket handshake. Client uses it as `?ticket=<value>` query param. Replaces legacy `?token=<access_jwt>` pattern which leaked JWT into nginx/Gateway logs.

post.summary: Authenticate via Telegram Mini App
post.description: Validate Telegram initData (HMAC-SHA256) and return JWT token pair. Cookie also set for web-panel fallback; TMA clients read refreshToken from body.

401.description: Invalid or tampered initData, or user not linked

post.summary: Refresh access token
post.description: Read refresh token from HttpOnly cookie 'rct_refresh', rotate it, return new access in body + new cookie.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired refresh cookie

post.summary: Read LOGIN status using the issuing browser capability
Preview browser login without approving it
Exchange an approved challenge for the normal Auth session
Explicitly approve or reject browser login
Issue or reissue a browser-bound LOGIN challenge
Verify a password-reset OTP without a login session

200.description: OTP accepted; returns only a reset ticket

410.description: OTP has expired or was consumed

post.summary: Request a password-reset OTP through Telegram

202.description: Accepts exactly one of login or telegramId without disclosing account status

post.summary: Set a new password with a verified one-use reset ticket

204.description: Password updated and all previous sessions revoked

400.description: New password does not meet the password policy

410.description: Reset ticket is invalid, expired, or already used

post.summary: Verify OTP code
post.description: Verify OTP code and receive JWT token pair + refresh cookie

post.summary: Verify OTP code without telegram ID
post.description: Verify OTP code by reverse lookup (code → telegramId). Used by web-panel where the user only enters the 6-digit code received in Telegram bot. M16 G3: brute-force защита по IP — 20 mismatch'ей за 5 мин → 429.

post.summary: Request OTP code
post.description: Generate OTP code for Telegram-based authentication. M09 G2 (08 P0-2): код отправляется пользователю через notification-bot (RabbitMQ event otp.requested), НЕ возвращается в HTTP body.

204.description: OTP code generated and dispatched to Telegram bot

post.summary: Revoke the current session
Revoke all sessions for the current user
Login with credentials
post.description: Authenticate with login and password, returns JWT token pair + refresh cookie

post.summary: Issue an own-group one-use recovery link
Generate a version-checked own-group password
Change the current user's password
Issue a one-use recovery link under a current active ADMIN session

get.summary: List the current user's live sessions

get.description: Returns RSA public key in PEM format for JWT verification

get.summary: Read a current own-group generated credential
Read the current user's account security history

delete.summary: Revoke one of the current user's sessions
